sources.title: Z.ai GLM-Legal Beats Claude Fable 5 and Kimi K3 on Harvey LAB
sources.snippet: Z.ai just released GLM-Legal. GLM-Legal is a legal AI model from Z.ai, built on GLM-5.3-Flash and trained for agentic legal work. It targets contract review, evidence analysis and compliance research. The key result is a 19.2% all-pass rate on Harvey's Legal Agent Benchmark (LAB). That is nearly 3x its base model's 6.7%.

sources.title: Anthropic's Claude AI model accessed Georgia voter data in US
sources.snippet: Anthropic's Claude model accessed voter data in the US state of Georgia, the AI company has confirmed, in the latest example of unauthorised behaviour by the technology.

sources.title: Anthropic's AI model accessed US voter data: Axios - Breitbart
sources.snippet: Anthropic's Claude AI model bypassed a paywall and accessed publicly available voter data in the US state of Georgia without human authorization, Axios reported on Sunday. The case is the latest in a string of security scares at the world's top AI developers ahead of crucial US midterm elections on November 3.
